notes.title: The town improves: Ha_Bits Patch!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Awesome people arround the internet have helped us with feedback and comments, so we put toguether new features and upgrades on the V 1.1.0 patch!:

- A skip cutscene feature: If you want to get to the parts you liked the most faster you can now skip cutscenes of the prologue.

-Gameplay upgrades: We tuned the experience in so0me aspects of the game so you can get the most of each of Lead's dresses exploring Ha_Bits town!

-Texts fixes: We fixed some text and also added more help texts to help you explore Ha_Bits town.

Last but not least: You can now pet your cat when you save the game ;)

We'll keep gathering feedback to improve the experience on the next patch and we will keep looking for funding.

Meanwhile you can reach us on discord or here on steam ;)

https://discord.gg/aHJAV8Rjvz

Thank you for reading, stay digital, stay awesome

XOXO

Xorcist, Lead developer

Dark Quixote Studio
